author: AI-assisted draft for clinical lead review

questions.label: Are you having abdominal (tummy) pain now, or have you had episodes recently?
options: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: How strong is the abdominal pain right now?
options: Mild — I can carry on with usual activities
Severe — I cannot carry on with usual activities
questions.help: Describe the pain now, not the worst pain in the past.

questions.label: How did this episode of pain begin?
options: Very suddenly, over seconds or minutes
Longstanding pain that has recently become worse
Longstanding pain without a recent change

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: Where do you feel the abdominal pain? Choose all areas that apply.

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.help: Use your own right and left. You can select more than one area.

questions.label: Without pressing to test it, have you noticed pain from light touch or an unusually hard tummy?
questions.help: Do not press on your tummy to answer this question.

questions.label: Have you felt lightheaded, or actually passed out?
options: Lightheaded or dizzy, without passing out

questions.label: When did the lightheadedness or fainting most recently happen?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped

values: Lightheaded or dizzy, without passing out

questions.label: How is the person affected now?
options: Fully recovered and back to usual
Still lightheaded but able to sit and talk normally
Not fully recovered, hard to wake, or difficulty speaking or moving
Feels about to collapse and cannot stand safely

values: Lightheaded or dizzy, without passing out

questions.help: If the patient cannot answer, a person with them can describe what they observe.

questions.label: Did the faint happen with any of these features?
options: With chest pain or a racing/irregular heartbeat
With a serious injury or shaking/jerking

questions.label: Has there been a change in awareness, orientation or ability to think clearly?
options: A new change in awareness or confusion
Longstanding memory/confusion problems without a new change
questions.help: For example, not knowing where you are or being unable to follow a conversation.

questions.label: How did this new change in awareness begin?
options: Suddenly, and it is happening now or happened today
A past episode that has resolved

values: A new change in awareness or confusion

questions.label: Have you noticed blood or material like coffee grounds in vomit?
When did the blood or coffee-ground material in vomit occur?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped

questions.label: How much blood or coffee-ground material was there?
questions.help: Use the detail box for an approximate amount; do not delay getting help to measure it.

questions.label: During that bleeding episode, was there faintness, new confusion, cold clammy skin, fast breathing or abdominal pain?
options: Yes, with the same bleeding episode
No, none of these during the bleeding
These happened at a different time

questions.label: Has your stool looked unusually black?
options: Dark stool but not sticky or tar-like

questions.label: When did the black stool last occur?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped

values: Dark stool but not sticky or tar-like

questions.label: Have you noticed red blood when passing stool or from the bottom?
options: Blood on the paper or outside the stool
Blood mixed into the stool or toilet water

questions.label: When did the red bleeding last occur?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped

values: Blood on the paper or outside the stool
Blood mixed into the stool or toilet water

questions.label: How much red bleeding was there in the most recent episode?
options: More than streaks, but not a large amount
A large amount, large clots, or bleeding that will not stop

values: Blood on the paper or outside the stool
Blood mixed into the stool or toilet water

questions.label: When have you been vomiting?
options: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: On a day with vomiting, about how many times does it happen?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: What happens when you try to drink fluids today?
options: Even small sips come back up

questions.label: How long have drinks been difficult to keep down?

values: Even small sips come back up

questions.label: How much urine are you passing today compared with usual?
options: Very little or none for many hours
Unable to pass urine despite needing to

questions.label: Is your tummy unusually swollen or bloated?
options: Comes and goes; not swollen now

questions.label: Are you able to pass stool and wind (gas) now?
options: Unable to pass either stool or gas

questions.label: Are the swelling, vomiting and inability to pass stool or gas happening together in the same current episode?

values: Unable to pass either stool or gas

questions.label: Have the whites of your eyes or your skin become yellow?
options: Yellow in the past, not now

questions.label: Have you had a fever or felt unusually hot during this illness?
options: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.label: Do chills or shaking shivers happen with the fever?

values: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.label: Are the yellowing, fever and upper-right tummy pain occurring together in this illness?
options: No, these happened at different times

questions.label: What, if anything, is difficult to swallow?
options: Food sticks, but liquids go down
Both food and liquids are difficult

questions.label: Can you swallow your own saliva right now?
options: Cannot swallow saliva / drooling because it will not go down

questions.label: What is the main problem you want your care team to help with?
questions.help: Use your own words, including anything the options do not capture.

questions.label: When did the main problem first start?
How has the main problem changed recently?
When did you first start having this abdominal pain?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: What is the pattern of the pain?
options: Comes and goes, with pain-free periods
One episode that has now stopped

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: How often do painful episodes happen?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: How long does a typical painful episode last?
options: Most of the day or longer

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: At its worst during this illness, how strong has the pain been (0–10)?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.help: 0 means no pain; 10 means the worst pain you can imagine. This is separate from your pain right now.

questions.label: What does the pain feel like?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: Does the pain spread anywhere?
options: Groin or side of the waist

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: How does eating affect the pain?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: Does your position affect the pain?

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: What usually makes the pain settle?
options: Relieved by passing stool or wind
Relieved by tablets or home remedies

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: If you have had pain before, what is different this time?
options: Lasts longer or no longer settles

values: Pain comes and goes; no pain right now
Pain happened before but has stopped

questions.label: When did the vomiting first start?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: What does the vomit usually look like?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: When did this blood or coffee-ground material last occur?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped
questions.help: Clarify this even if an earlier answer was different.

questions.label: Did faintness, confusion, clammy skin, fast breathing or tummy pain occur with this bleeding?
options: No, none of these during the bleeding

questions.label: About how much comes up each time?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.help: If possible, estimate millilitres (mL), or give the size of the cup/container and fraction filled. Say it is an estimate.

questions.label: How is vomiting related to meals?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: Do you feel nauseated before vomiting?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: How do you feel after vomiting?

values: Vomiting on and off, but not today
Vomiting earlier in this illness, now stopped

questions.label: Did blood appear before or after repeated retching?
When did the fever first start?

values: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.label: What is the pattern of the fever?

values: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.label: How did the fever start?

values: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.label: What temperature was measured, if any?

values: Fever on earlier days, not today

questions.help: Give the number, °C or °F, and when it was measured. If no thermometer was used, say felt feverish, not measured.

questions.label: Do you have burning or acid coming back up?
options: Sour or bitter fluid in the mouth

questions.label: How often does the burning or acid coming up happen?

values: Sour or bitter fluid in the mouth

questions.label: When did the burning or acid coming up start?

values: Sour or bitter fluid in the mouth

questions.label: When is the burning or acid coming up most noticeable?
options: When lying down or at night

values: Sour or bitter fluid in the mouth

questions.label: How often do you feel bloated or uncomfortably full in the upper tummy?
Does eating a small amount make you feel too full to finish a usual meal?
options: Sometimes full after a small amount
Usually full after a small amount

questions.label: How has your appetite changed?
When did the reduced appetite or early fullness start?

values: Sometimes full after a small amount
Usually full after a small amount

questions.label: What has happened to your weight?
options: Clothes looser, but weight not checked

questions.label: What were your previous and current weights, and when?

values: Clothes looser, but weight not checked

questions.help: Give kg and dates or the time between weights. Say measured on a scale or estimated; do not invent a number.

questions.label: When was yellowing first noticed?

values: Yellow in the past, not now

questions.label: How did the yellowing start?

values: Yellow in the past, not now

questions.label: How has the yellowing changed?

values: Yellow in the past, not now

questions.label: What colour has the urine been during the yellowing?

values: Yellow in the past, not now

questions.label: Where, if anywhere, are you itching?
When did the itching start?
How much does itching affect you?
options: Does not affect sleep or activities

questions.label: How are your bowel habits different from usual?
options: Urgency or a feeling of incomplete emptying

questions.label: When did the bowel change begin?

values: Urgency or a feeling of incomplete emptying

questions.label: Did the bowel change start suddenly or gradually?

values: Urgency or a feeling of incomplete emptying

questions.label: How are the bowel changes developing?

values: Urgency or a feeling of incomplete emptying

questions.label: How often do you pass stool now, compared with before?
questions.help: Give a count per day or per week for now and for usual. Include night-time visits if any.

questions.label: Have you tried anything to help pass stool or control diarrhoea?

values: Urgency or a feeling of incomplete emptying

questions.help: Give its name, how long you used it and whether it helped, or say nothing tried.

questions.label: What does your stool usually look like during this illness?
When did this black sticky or blood-stained stool last occur?
options: Within the past week, now stopped
More than a week ago, now stopped
questions.help: Clarify this even if an earlier answer was different.

questions.label: How much blood was there in this stool episode?
options: More than streaks, but not a large amount
A large amount, large clots, or bleeding that will not stop

questions.label: How often is there mucus or a jelly-like coating in the stool?
How often have you noticed red blood from the bottom?

values: Blood on the paper or outside the stool
Blood mixed into the stool or toilet water

questions.label: Is there anything else to describe about the bleeding?

values: Blood on the paper or outside the stool
Blood mixed into the stool or toilet water

questions.help: For example clots, pain when passing stool, or bleeding separate from bowel movements.

questions.label: When did difficulty swallowing begin?

values: Food sticks, but liquids go down
Both food and liquids are difficult

questions.label: How is swallowing changing?

values: Food sticks, but liquids go down
Both food and liquids are difficult

questions.label: Is swallowing painful?

values: Food sticks, but liquids go down
Both food and liquids are difficult

questions.label: How is tiredness affecting your usual activities?
options: More tired but can do usual activities
Need to rest during usual activities
Too tired to manage usual activities

questions.label: When do you feel short of breath?
options: With usual walking or daily activity

questions.label: Have you been told you have anaemia (low haemoglobin)?
What was the haemoglobin result, and when was it checked?
questions.help: Give the number, units and test date if known. A reported result is separate from a verified report.

questions.label: Have you noticed a new lump or a localised swelling in your tummy?
options: A longstanding lump that has changed

questions.label: Where is the lump and when did you first notice it?

values: A longstanding lump that has changed

questions.label: Are you taking any medicines or remedies currently or recently?
Which medicines or remedies have you taken, and for how long?
questions.help: Include painkillers, blood thinners, iron, acidity medicines and herbal remedies. Add dose if known; names can be checked with staff.

questions.label: Do you have any known medicine or food allergies?
What caused the allergic reaction, and what happened?
What illnesses have you been diagnosed with, and when?
questions.help: Include diabetes (especially recent onset), liver disease, hepatitis, ulcers, gallstones and other conditions. Say none known only if that is accurate.

questions.label: Have you had operations or hospital admissions?
questions.help: Describe what was done, why, and the approximate date, or say none.

questions.label: Has a blood relative had a digestive-system cancer or bowel polyps?
options: Bowel polyps in a blood relative
Both cancer and polyps in the family

questions.label: Which relative, what cancer or polyp diagnosis, and at what age?

values: Bowel polyps in a blood relative
Both cancer and polyps in the family

questions.help: Include stomach, bowel, food pipe, liver, gallbladder and pancreas if known.

questions.label: Have you used tobacco (smoked or chewed)?
What tobacco, how much and for how many years?
questions.help: For example cigarettes per day or chewing portions per day, years used and when stopped.

questions.label: Have you chewed betel nut / areca nut or paan?
How much betel/areca or paan, for how long, and does it contain tobacco?
Do you drink alcohol?
What do you drink, how much and how often?
questions.help: Describe drink type, serving volume (mL), days per week, years used and when stopped.

questions.label: Have you ever been tested or treated for hepatitis?
What test or treatment did you have, and when?
Any past tuberculosis or close contact with someone with TB?
options: No known TB or close contact
Previously diagnosed or treated for TB
Both past TB and close contact

questions.label: Please describe the TB diagnosis, treatment or contact and approximate dates.

values: Previously diagnosed or treated for TB
Both past TB and close contact

questions.label: Have you had night sweats during this illness?
options: Sweating that soaks clothes or bedding

questions.label: What is the approximate date you first noticed this problem?
questions.help: An approximate month or season is useful if you cannot remember the date.

questions.label: Who did you first consult about this problem?
When was the first consultation for this problem?
questions.help: Give an approximate date or how many days/weeks after symptoms began.

questions.label: What was the problem treated as, and what treatment was tried?
questions.help: Include names if known and how long the treatment was used.

questions.label: What happened after the treatment?
How many consultations have you had for this problem before today?
Who referred you for this visit, and when?
questions.help: If you came on your own, say self-referred.

questions.label: Have you had tests for this problem?
options: Tests arranged, waiting to have them

questions.label: Which tests were done or arranged, when, and what were you told?

values: Tests arranged, waiting to have them

questions.help: Include endoscopy, colonoscopy, scans, biopsy and blood tests. You can continue without reports.

questions.label: Is there anything else your care team should know?
questions.help: Include concerns, symptoms not covered, or help you need with the questionnaire.

rules.reason: Pain is present now and is described as severe or unbearable.

values: Severe — I cannot carry on with usual activities

rules.author: AI-assisted draft for clinical lead review
rules.population: Adults aged 18 years and over; synthetic demonstration only
rules.unknownBehavior: An unknown/declined/missing term never satisfies this rule. Positive broad warning facts retain their prompt-review rule while details are incomplete; no-match still needs clinician review.
rules.timeRelationship: Pain is present now and is described as severe or unbearable.
rules.adaptation: Assumed draft adaptation of reference symptom advice to Indian clinic/hospital navigation; no emergency diagnosis or validation claim. Verbal current functional pain severity is separate from the clinical lead’s DRAFT 0–10 worst-pain bands. Felt fever is reported, not a measured threshold.
rules.patientAdvice: Please seek medical assistance now or go to a hospital. If you are at the clinic, tell staff now. Do not delay getting help to finish these questions or wait for AI.
rules.staffHandover: Pain is present now and is described as severe or unbearable. Check the recorded facts, timing and current condition.
